pins.definition: Unpleasant to look at; lacking physical beauty.
Unpleasant to look at; not attractive.
Not pleasant to look at; lacking beauty or attractiveness.

situation: A person is looking at a bizarre, misshapen painting that stands out starkly against the beautiful, symmetrical decor of an art gallery.
subject: the painting
brief: In a grand, perfectly symmetrical art gallery with elegant golden walls, a single painting stands on an easel. The painting itself is a jumble of discordant, jarring colors and twisted, asymmetrical shapes that seem to vibrate with visual noise. A viewer stands before it, nose wrinkled and eyes squinting in visible discomfort, leaning back as if the sight is physically repellent, while all other paintings in the room are harmonious landscapes.
prompt: In a grand, perfectly symmetrical art gallery with elegant golden walls, a single painting stands on an easel. The painting itself is a jumble of discordant, jarring colors and twisted, asymmetrical shapes that seem to vibrate with visual noise. A viewer stands before it, nose wrinkled and eyes squinting in visible discomfort, leaning back as if the sight is physically repellent, while all other paintings in the room are harmonious landscapes. surrealism in the manner of Magritte and Dalí, one impossible juxtaposition rendered with complete photographic conviction, still air, an empty horizon. One square illustration. The scene is fully rendered and fully inhabited — no silhouettes, no flat icons, no diagram, no empty schematic space. A single subject dominates the frame and everything else is arranged around it. Absolutely no text anywhere in the image: no letters, words, numbers, captions, labels, signage, logos, watermarks or pseudo-text.
